initial_state.description: pilot-change is approved and every canonical task is complete.

allowed_tool_calls.description: Use CLI status and verify every task is complete.
Use CLI archive with the exact current snapshot and summary.

required_observations.description: The terminal bundle is committed under the dated archive destination.
Derived INDEX records the archived proposal.

forbidden_side_effects.description: Terminal status, destination, or INDEX is edited without CLI.

assertions: The active directory no longer exists.
Terminal metadata and INDEX agree on the destination.

outcome.description: The proposal reaches a valid completed archive.

process.description: Fresh status precedes one archive command.

safety.description: Terminal state is changed only by CLI.

efficiency.description: No manual move or redundant archive call occurs.
